sentences.text:
Heard learned Senior Counsel Mr. H.R.A. Choudhury for the petitioners assisted by Mr. I.U.
Chowdhury and Mr. R.J. Baruah, learned Addl. P.P., Assam.

Page No.# 1/2 vs The State Of Assam on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76810466/
1 2.

The petitioners, namely, [1] Ashadur Rahman and [2] Abdur Rezzak Sheikh together have filed an application u/s 438 Cr.PC with prayer of pre-arrest bail as they are apprehending arrest in c o n n e c t i o n w i t h D h u b r i P o l i c e S t a t i o n C a s e N o .
3. I have considered the submissions at the bar with circumspection.
I have also perused the Case Diary.
4. The FIR is lodged by Sri Nipan Roy, A Junior Assistant against the petitioners.

The petitioner no.
1 is the Chairman of Zila Parishad and the petitioner no. 2 was an Ex-member of Dhubri Zila Parishad.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that the allegations have been made by Junior Assistant pertaining two years of misappropriation of funds for their personal gain without information to the informant, who is a Junior Assistant.
The office furnitures have been taken away by allegedly by the petitioners for their personal use as well.
There is an allegation of the using petrol for the official vehicle despite objections by the informant.
On the contrary, it is submitted that the CEO has lodged the complaint against Nipan Roy, who has suggested for his suspension due to the anomalies committed by him.
An FIR was also lodged against the informant.
The copies of the letter of the CEO as well as the FIR lodged by the CEO against the informant, will form a part of the record.

It is also submitted that the petitioner no. 1 had suggested to call for a meeting vide letter dated 24.02.2023 to discuss about the anomalies committed by the informant and thereafter,
immediately on 26.02.2023, the present FIR was lodged against him.
No case under Sections 420/406/409/468/471 IPC can be made out from the contents of the FIR.
5. The petitioners have appeared before the IO and their statements have been recorded.
6. In view of my foregoing discussions and considering all aspects, the order dated 21.03.2023 is hereby made absolute.
Send back the Case Diary.
